tha-ap503:1.3: sambuddho himavantamupāgamiṁ ajjhogayha himavantaṁ → bhagavā himavantamupāgami ajjhogahetvā hivavantaṁ (bj)
tha-ap503:1.4: himavantamupāgamiṁ ajjhogayha → himavantaṁ upāgami ajjhogahetvā (sya-all) | himavantamupāgami → mupāgamiṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap503:5.2: buddharaṁsībhidhāvare → buddharaṁsī vidhāvare (bj); buddharaṁsābhidhāvare (sya-all) | vidhāvare → buddharaṁsībhidhāvare (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap503:10.1: satabheṇḍu dhajāluharitāmayaṁ → sattageṇḍu dhajālu haritāmayo (sya-all) | satabheṇḍu → satageṇḍu (cck: syā.)
tha-ap503:10.2: dhajāluharitāmayaṁ satasahassaniyyūhā byamhe → dhajālu haritāmayaṁ satasahassaniyyuhā vyamhe (bj)
tha-ap503:11.2: lohitaṅgamayāpi → lohitaṅkamayāpi (bj) | lohitaṅgamayāpi ca phalikāpi ca → lohitaṅkamayāpica phalikāpica (sya-all)
tha-ap503:11.4: yadicchakā → yathicchakaṁ (sya-all) | yadicchakā → yenicchakā yadicchakaṁ (bj: syā) | yadicchakā → yenicchayā yadicchakaṁ (cck: syā.); yadicchakāyadicchakā (cck: ka.)
tha-ap503:12.2: tūlikāvikatīyutaṁ uddhalomikaekantaṁ bibbohanasamāyutaṁ → tulikāvikatīyutaṁ uddalomika ekantaṁ bimbohanasamāyutaṁ (bj) | tūlikāvikatīyutaṁ → tulikaṁ vikatissakaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap503:12.4: bibbohanasamāyutaṁ → bimbohanasamāyutaṁ (cck) | bimbohanasamāyutaṁ → bibbohanasamāyutaṁ… (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap503:15.2: sāyaṁ pātamupaṭṭhahuṁ → sāyapātamupaṭṭhahuṁ (cck) | pātamupaṭṭhahuṁ → pātaṁ upaṭṭhahuṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap503:37.2: mama buddhassa → buddhaseṭṭhassa (bj) | santike → mama buddhassa santike (bj: machasaṁ)
